notes: Example recipe. The classic bread for mopping up potjie sauce. Bake it in a flat-bottomed pot while the potjie finishes.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, salt and sugar. Add the oil and enough water for a soft dough.
Knead for 10 minutes until smooth. Cover and let it rise in a warm spot until doubled, about 1 hour.
Knock it down, shape it, and put it in the buttered pot. Let it rise again for 30 minutes.
Set the pot on a few coals and put coals on the lid. More heat on top than below.
Bake for about 1 hour. It's done when it sounds hollow when you tap it.
title: Simple Potbrood
